messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] controlplane.deps.5xx_rate threshold breached: 6.3% over last 3m. Sources: auth-service, org-lookup, billing-config. Pager -> alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): grabbing graphs + logs now. seeing error spike from gateway 502/504s to org-lookup. datadog: https://dd.example.com/dash/controlplane-deps (attached) :eyes:

maria (sre): on call too. can you share a sample error log? might be connection pool exhaustion or timeouts upstream.

alex (oncall): paste of recent errors: 
```
2026-06-10T18:02:14Z auth-lookup ERROR fetch org for tenant=acme timeout after 12000ms
2026-06-10T18:02:16Z billing-config WARN failed fetch 502 gateway from cfg-store-2
```

jon (prodeng): routing shows a sudden surge in config requests from rollout job ID r-9987 at ~18:00. could be a bad rollout hitting control plane. checking rollout service.

alex (oncall): rolling back that rollout would be safest if it's the source. can we pause it? @sam can you check the rollout controller?

sam (infra): pausing r-9987 now. api call: `kubectl patch rollout r-9987 --patch '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'` responded 200. pausing reduced call-rate to org-lookup by ~40% in the last 30s.

alex (oncall): nice, 5xx rate falling but still above baseline (now 3.2%). we should also open a circuit on gateway to fail fast for heavy callers. maria, can you add a temporary route-level circuit breaker?

maria (sre): adding a short TTL circuit for heavy callers, config applied: `gateway.route('/v1/config').circuitBreaker({errorThresholdPercentage:50, resetTimeout:30000})`. will push in 30s.

incident-bot: [ACTION] Circuit breaker rule applied by maria at 18:06 UTC.

priya (support): customer inbox is getting a handful of tickets re: 502s on app startup. priority customers: Acme Corp, BetaApps. estimating ~150 requests failed in last 15m. passing to lisa for comms.

lisa (cust-suc): drafting status message for affected customers with context + mitigation steps. will post to status.redwood.ai after triage.

alex (oncall): quick customer impact note for postmortem: > spike impacted config fetches and auth lookups, causing transient 5xx on new sessions and startup flows. Not all requests affected due to caching.

maria (sre): still seeing elevated latencies to cfg-store-2 (timeouts around 12s). adding a temporary fallback to cfg-store-1 replica and enabling aggressive cache TTL extension for 5 minutes: `cache.ttl=300s`

sam (infra): promoting cfg-store-1 read-capacity and taking cfg-store-2 into maintenance window. scaling replica set +10 pods.

incident-bot: [INFO] scaling actions initiated for cfg-store.

alex (oncall): re-run health checks against control plane deps: 
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://controlplane.internal/health/deps
200 0.178
```

jon (prodeng): telemetry shows 5xx now down to 0.9% over last 2m. rolling metrics look good. keeping circuits for 10 more mins then reevaluate.

priya (support): customer pings reduced, CS confirmed decreased ticket volume. Lisa, ready to publish preliminary update?

lisa (cust-suc): posting short update now: "Investigating elevated errors affecting some customers. Mitigations deployed (rollback, circuit breakers, replica scaling). We will follow up with root cause once validated." :loudspeaker:

maria (sre): starting post-incident data capture: collect spans for 18:00-18:20, config fetch logs, and rollout controller logs. tagging traces with `incident/1765556666`.

alex (oncall): handing off to maria for final cleanup and RCA. I'm marking as acknowledged and moving to monitoring. maria, take it from here and escalate to eng-runtime if you need kernel-level tuning.

maria (sre): ack. I'll run through full RCA and timeline. initial hypothesis: rollout r-9987 caused a burst of config reads which exhausted connection pools on cfg-store-2 leading to timeouts and downstream 502s; secondary factor: cache TTLs were short so retries amplified load.

alex (oncall): thanks team. next oncall (tomorrow) is @maria. leaving notes in the incident doc and will attach the datadog links.

incident-bot: [Handoff] oncall changed -> maria (next). Incident thread will remain open for RCA.

lisa (cust-suc): customer follow-up scheduled for 20:00 UTC. will include mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix.

maria (sre): last checks show stable metrics at 0.6% 5xx. scheduling RCA doc and ops followup. closing paging for now but keeping thread open until RCA published.

priya (support): marking CS cases as "monitoring - temp mitigation applied".

incident-bot: [CLOSE] Paging cleared at 18:31 UTC.

alex (oncall): closing my active pager. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria (sre): will publish RCA with timeline + permanent mitigations (better rollout throttling, cache TTL defaults, improved circuit coverage) within 24h.
